It asked her to confirm the two-year manufacturer's warranty for a free heating element in writing and to give a firm repair date, because 'maybe in two weeks' is not a booking. A follow-up was set for 7 June (A5) and the ticket was put on hold with a review date (A8). The agent could not confirm a date itself because the call dropped, so chasing for a firm date is the right step and meets this outcome.
